description:
Initiates the deletion of a Managed Airflow environment.

Warning: This is a destructive action permanently deletes an environment and can't be undone.
Always ask the user to confirm the deletion before proceeding.

This tool triggers the environment deletion process, which is a long-running operation that
typically takes 10-20 minutes. The tool returns an operation object. Use the `get_operation`
tool with the operation name returned by this tool to poll for deletion status.

name.description: The environment to delete, in the form: "projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/environments/{environmentId}"

name: delete_environment
